featured_reviews.name: Sona Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Granth at Taj Santacruz , Mumbai is a rare gem of a bookstore with an absolute legend of a staff member!

I had the most wonderful experience at the Granth , and I had to leave a review to specifically commend one of its staff member Mr Shubham Mishra  for  his customer service that was nothing short of masterful.

The store itself is a treasure trove—beautifully lit, impeccably clean, and so well-organized that you feel welcomed the moment you step inside. It’s clear a lot of care goes into curating the selection. They have an incredible range of books for every age group, from whimsical children's picture books to thought-provoking literary fiction including a delightful collection of sacred artefacts, tarot cards, and other unique items interspersed throughout. It gives the place a very special, almost magical atmosphere.

While i was busy browsing through the sections of my interest, without being  intrusive in the slightest; Mr Shubham Mishra simply observed from a respectful distance, clearly trying to gauge my interests without disturbing my flow. It was a subtle art—distant, unobtrusive observation—and it was incredibly effective.

After a few minutes, he politely approached. Without any pressure or small talk, he simply said, "If you're interested in that author, you might also appreciate these," and gently placed a set of related books on a table besides me .They were all perfect suggestions, one that showed he truly understood the theme I was exploring.

Then, he did something I wish every bookseller would do: he simply , smiled, and vanished  as quietly as he had appeared giving  me the needed space and silence to browse through the books, to read the first few pages, and to decide for myself if it was the right fit. There was no hovering, no sales pitch—just expert guidance delivered with the utmost respect for the reader's private journey.

This level of attentive, intelligent, and graceful service is incredibly rare. He didn't just sell me the books; he enhanced my entire experience and deepened my love for browsing physical bookstores.

If you're looking for a perfect book or a unique gift in a serene and welcoming environment,with sincere expertise and assistance of Mr Shubham Mishra ,do yourself a favor and visit [Granth The Booktore at Taj Santacruz , Mumbai I know I'll be back.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sona Sharma,

Thank you for your lovely words about Granth Bookstore at Taj Santacruz. We are truly happy to know you had such a memorable experience.

Your appreciation for Shubham Mishra means a lot to us. Creating a calm and meaningful browsing experience for our readers is at the heart of what we do.

We look forward to welcoming you again soon.

Warm regards,
Team Granth

- You will mostly find bussiness and managment books or latest popular books
- Great classic scholars are missing from there shelves
- you can get good mass level books very limited collection of class level books
- they only sell english books ... No other languages at all
- they sell books on MRP even those which are available on discount
- overall an average store for a book lover
